name: חֲשֻׁבָה
summary: A son of Zerubbabel, listed with Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-hesed (1Ch 3:19–20). The name is from חָשַׁב, in the form of a passive participle, “esteemed, held of account”, or a noun “regard”; it stands among brothers' names that speak of Yahweh's dealings (Berechiah “Yahweh blesses”, Hasadiah “Yahweh is kind”, Jushab-hesed “kindness returns”), born in the exile. Scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “וַחֲשֻׁבָה and Ohel and Berechiah and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.”
“We did not esteem him (חֲשַׁבְנֻהוּ)”: the root's sense of regard.

note: Takes h.gr.ac (1 token). The meaning is a reading of the form only.
